question: A cord is in the form of a square enclosing an area of 22 cm². If the same cord is formed into a circle, then find the area enclosed by that circle. [Take pi =(22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

Area of the square = 22 cm².

Formula used:

Area of the circle = πr²

Perimeter of the circle= 2πr

Area of the square = side2

Concept used:

The perimeter of the circle and the square will be the same when the same cord is bent to form the circle and the square.

Calculation:

Area of the square = 22 cm2

⇒ side, (a) = √22 = √22 cm

According to question,

Perimeter of the square

= Perimeter of the circle

= 4 × √(22)

= 4√22 cm

Now, Perimeter of the circle = 2πr

⇒ 2πr = 4√22

⇒ r = 2√22/π cm

So, Area of the circle

= πr²

= π × ((2√22)/(π))²

= (88)/(π)

= (88)/(frac{22){7}}

= 28 cm²

∴ The area is inclosed by the circle is 28 cm2 .
